SELECT a.account_id, l.amount, l.date FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.duration > 12 AND a.date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-12-31' AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan WHERE account_id = a.account_id AND duration > 12)
